# Kontoor Brands Completes the Sale of the Lee® Business to Authentic Brands Group


[Download as PDF](https://www.kontoorbrands.com/_assets/_88ba8155565f80e4163fc7ee85480b37/kontoorbrands/news/2026-11-03_Kontoor_Brands_Completes_the_Sale_of_the_Lee_247.pdf) November 03, 2026 6:50am EST


GREENSBORO, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) today announced it has completed the sale of the *Lee* ® business to Authentic Brands Group.


"I want to thank the Kontoor team for the tremendous effort that drove the successful completion of this transaction," said Scott Baxter, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board of Kontoor Brands. “We now have a more focused, growth-oriented portfolio positioned to deliver stronger returns for our shareholders.”


"We are grateful to the Lee team for their contributions to Kontoor and wish them well as they write the next chapter of the brand's iconic history," Baxter added.


***Advisors***


Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC is serving as Kontoor Brands’ exclusive financial advisor and Foley & Lardner LLP as its legal advisor.


***About Kontoor Brands***


Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) is a global apparel company with deep authority in the denim, outdoor and workwear categories. *Wrangler* ® and *Helly Hansen* ® are iconic brands that empower consumers to pursue their passions with confidence and authenticity through innovative design, exceptional products and compelling performance. Kontoor's global platform, scale and operational expertise drive sustainable brand growth and deliver long-term value for its stakeholders. For more information, please visit[www.KontoorBrands.com](http://www.kontoorbrands.com/) .

volatility in the price and trading volume of the Company's common stock; anti-takeover provisions in the Company's organizational documents; market conditions, timing and ability to institute an appropriate Accelerated Share Repurchase program; and general fluctuations in the amount and frequency under our share repurchases. Many of the foregoing risks and uncertainties will be exacerbated by any worsening of the global business and economic environment.
